correctness.rationale: Every bounded morphism satisfies f(T_x)=U_{f(x)}. For each child cone, every immediate target child v is covered precisely when that child cone root maps to t or v. The independent choices for source-child cones and inclusion-exclusion over uncovered target children yield the exact recurrence, with all base cases included. Induction on source subtree order proves it, and amortizing over all source edges gives the stated arithmetic-operation bound. Two distinct recurrences matched on 28,016 tree-type pairs, direct enumeration checked 22,132,644 total functions across 936 pairs, and isomorphism enumeration independently checked 2,807 equal-size pairs. Finite tests are corroboration, not the proof.

A uniform formula and target-branching fixed-parameter algorithm for every finite rooted-tree pair, with illustrative star and binary-chain specializations, give a structural invariant over an unrestricted infinite graph family rather than a routine isolated finite computation.
